title: [FMP-10] 다직무 협업·보고·수신확인·인계·교관 운영
executionMode: PM aggregates child deliverables; members and their LLMs execute child work.

assignment.policy: 실제 착수 시 claim. 사전 개인 배정 금지.

environment: 장소·학교 PC·개인 PC·고사양 장비 보유로 작업을 제한하지 않는다. 특정 OS/HMD는 해당 시험의 검증 조건일 뿐 배정 조건이 아니다.
directive: 여러 직무 팀이 같은 사건·설비·NPC를 공유하며 구조화 보고·수신확인·명시적 인계와 교관 제어를 실제 서버 응답과 UI에서 수행한다.

flow.prepare: Read this packet and only its current-phase sources. Identify missing inputs, plan exact changes and tests. Do not claim another member’s work.
flow.candidate: After candidate-phase inputs are qualified, claim exact paths/branch and perform the implementation or verification requested here.
flow.accept: Run every required check, preserve failed/unrun cases, return evidence. PM evaluates handoff; a document or checkbox alone is not completion.

relations.parallelCondition: Candidate-phase plan only. Required inputs must be available, actual branches/checkouts and mutable resources must be separate, and exact write claims must not overlap. This is not a live lease or an assignment.

handoff: checks actually run and their result

technicalContract.scope: Exact phase inputs, artifact qualifications, write/resource contracts, checks and evidence. Historical capture/review fields are not current assignments or a mandatory review loop.

sourceSnapshot.liveState: Read GitHub Project at actual start; this packet grants no live lease or blanket external-action permission.
